title: AgreementEventIntentEnum
description: Defines the intent of the agreement event. An agreement event may cover multiple business scenarios, which result in different agreement lifecycle events.

oneOf.title: AmendedAndRestated
oneOf.description: Represents a change in terms and or parties where the agreement is required to be restated in its entirety.

oneOf.title: AmendedParties
oneOf.description: Represents a change to the contractual parties to an agreement through the process of addition or deletion.

oneOf.title: AmendedTerms
oneOf.description: Specifies that an agreement event results in updated agreement terms for the overall legal agreement to which the agreement event applies.

oneOf.title: Novation
oneOf.description: Represents a change where certain trades will be moved to a different agreement while the existing agreement remains in place.

oneOf.title: Superseded
oneOf.description: Represents a change where an agreement is being superseded by another existing agreement and the agreement that is being amended is being terminated as a function of this process.

oneOf.title: Termination
oneOf.description: Represents a change that results in the related agreement being terminated.
